title: CreateCapacityFreeze
description: Command payload for Station Operations to ask the Booking module to commit a capacity freeze; correlation and causation identifiers and the aggregate reference travel in the CloudEvents envelope

commandRef.description: Unique command reference used for idempotency

stationRef.description: Station reference the freeze scope is based on

evseRef.description: EVSE reference (present when the freeze scope is a single EVSE)

interval.description: Half-open interval in UTC to freeze

reason.description: Structured reason for the freeze request

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp; expired commands must not execute
